avr.text: Relov is an Azorius arbiter whom Javy leads to a tenement, where he sees the corpse of Zivan with words carved into every inch of his skin.

Javy shows him an old Mass Arrest Order for the Golgari Undercity sweep and points out that everyone who signed it is dead except him, so Relov files an Application for Constant Protection as soon as he returns to New Prahv.
At midnight Javy confronts him in his townhouse about signing the order, and Vraska sweeps in, telling him that she resolved that all should receive the death they deserve.
Vraska lets Javy choose his death and she names inaction, so Relov is turned to stone and his statue is installed near the main gate, where it is mistaken for one of Grand Arbiter Leonos.
